title: Photos: The Aftermath of Nepal’s Flash Floods
text:
Jiang Fan / Xinhua / Getty

 This photo shows search-and-rescue operations under way at the mudslide-hit area in Gyirong County, China’s Xizang Autonomous Region, on August 29, 2026.

 Rajesh Kumar Singh / AP

 A drone view shows rescue workers inspecting damaged structures following flash flooding along the Trishuli River in the Devighat area of Nuwakot district, Nepal, on August 29, 2026.

 Niranjan Shrestha / AP

 A student searches for her schoolbag in a pile of backpacks extracted from the mud in the Shree Bagheswori Madhyamik School in Galchhi, Dhading district, Nepal, on August 30, 2026.

 Rajesh Kumar Singh / AP

 A drone view of a bridge damaged by the flooding in the Tadi River in the Devighat area of Nuwakot district, Nepal, on August 29, 2026

 Dar Yasin / AP

 People look at photographs of unidentified flood victims displayed outside a government hospital to help relatives identify their loved ones in Kathmandu, Nepal, on August 28, 2026.

 Arun Sankar / AFP / Getty

 Police personnel rescue stranded residents from a house buried in sludge after flash flooding along the Trishuli River in Nepal, on August 27, 2026.

 Rajesh Kumar Singh / AP

 Damaged homes filled with mud and debris are seen in Devighat, Nepal, on August 29, 2026.

 Daniel Ceng / Anadolu / Getty

 A rescue helicopter takes off for an evacuation operation in Nuwakot, Nepal, on August 29, 2026.

 Prabin Ranabhat / AFP / Getty

 Rescued residents react as they meet family members at an army camp after the flooding, in Battar Bazar, Nepal, on August 28, 2026.

 Sameer Shrestha / Anadolu / Getty

 An aerial view of the extensive destruction and debris deposits along the Trishuli River, following a catastrophic outburst flood in Bidur, Nepal, on August 28, 2026

 Daniel Ceng / Anadolu / Getty

 Rescuers transfer belongings and debris from a house damaged by the flash flood, as search-and-rescue efforts continue in a town along the Trishuli River, in Nepal, on August 31, 2026.

 Sameer Shrestha / Anadolu / Getty

 An aerial view of damaged and mud-covered solar panels along the Trishuli River in Bidur, Nepal, on August 28, 2026

 Niranjan Shrestha / AP

 A partially buried truck on the bank of the Trishuli River in Nepal’s Dhading district on August 30, 2026

 Rajesh Kumar Singh / AP

 Rescue workers inspect damaged structures along the Trishuli River in Nepal’s Nuwakot district on August 29, 2026.

 Manan Vatsyayana / AFP / Getty

 Splashed mud dries on the door of a house in Nepal’s Nuwakot district on August 29, 2026.

 Manan Vatsyayana / AFP / Getty

 A man climbs out of a window after searching for his belongings inside his house in Nuwakot district on August 29, 2026.

 Manan Vatsyayana / AFP / Getty

 A room is seen heavily covered in mud inside a flood-damaged house in Nepal’s Nuwakot district on August 29, 2026.

 Ritesh Shukla / Getty

 A cat walks through debris and mud left by the flooding in Devighat, Nepal, on August 28, 2026.

 Daniel Ceng / Anadolu / Getty

 A woman and her child living along the Trishuli River take shelter on higher ground after fleeing their home early in the morning, as authorities issued a new flash-flood warning, in Bidir, Nuwakot, Nepal, on August 30, 2026.

 Jigme Dorje / Xinhua / Getty

 A drone photo shows a mudslide-hit area in Nepal on August 27, 2026.

 Tenzing Nima Qadhup / Xinhua / Getty

 Rescuers work in a mudslide-hit area in Gyirong County, in China’s Xizang Autonomous Region, on August 29, 2026.

 Prakash Mathema / AFP / Getty

 Army personnel conduct a search-and-rescue operation for flood victims along the Narayani River at Bharatpur in Nepal’s Chitwan district on August 30, 2026.

 Navesh Chitrakar / Reuters

 A police officer stands near identification number tags for bodies at the Devghat mass burial site for victims of the flooding, in Chitwan, Nepal, on August 30, 2026.

 Ezra Acayan / Getty

 Police and army personnel bury unidentified bodies recovered from the flash floods at a mass burial site in the Devghat Forest on August 30, 2026, in Bharatpur, Nepal.

 Dar Yasin / AP

 Relatives console Muna Khadka, who lost her son, Aayush Khada, in the flooding, during mass burials in Chitwan, Nepal, on August 31, 2026.

 Dar Yasin / AP

 Numbered identification tags placed in pots mark the graves of flash-flood victims at a mass burial site in Chitwan on August 31, 2026.

 Athit Perawongmetha / Reuters

 A relative of Prabita Roila, who lost her life in the flash floods, lights her funeral pyre beside the Suryamati River in Trishuli, Nepal, on August 30, 2026.
